source: Current user Tulip growth reference attachment
bulb: One tan pear-shaped fibrous bulb with a tapered papery neck and small basal roots
sprout: Same bulb, two tightly rolled green shoots
young: Three broad smooth strap-shaped leaves with pointed curved tips
bud: Two opposing broad leaves, continuous green stalk and one tapered rose-pink bud with green basal transition
ready: One pink cup, six overlapping rounded fleshy tepals, open upper cavity, two broad arching green leaves, no exposed bulb
harvest: Single cut tulip lying on its side, open flower at the left, long curved stem to the right and one broad attached leaf
direction: Thick cupped petal volumes, smooth edges, registered vertical fibres and vivid fresh colour
